scenes.title: A loaded map follows the selected or fixed channel

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Before mapped input
steps.caption: The fresh child session loads a saved PMAP fixture. Before CC input, both output ports preserve the authored velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97.

steps.title: Turn the selected-channel control
steps.caption: Eleven CC20 increases set channel 1’s velocity mask to 10; channel 2 still plays its authored velocities. Input CC value 65 is an increase in this relative binary-offset fixture.

steps.title: Move channel selection
steps.caption: Select channel 2, then send three CC20 increases. Channel 1 retains velocity 8; channel 2 now emits velocity 2.

steps.title: A fixed-channel control ignores selection
steps.caption: With channel 1 selected, two CC21 increases still edit channel 2. Output velocities are 8 on port 1 and 4 on port 2.

steps.title: Zero is a relative decrease
steps.caption: CC21 value 0 decreases channel 2’s velocity mask from 4 to 3; port 1 remains at 8.

scenes.title: Announce song patterns to an Elektron receiver

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Program changes start off
steps.caption: With the Digitakt configuration loaded, playback and stopped song-slot selection emit no program changes while the option is off.

steps.title: Enable the option in PARAMS
steps.caption: The native Mosaic parameter row visibly reads On after enabling Elektron program changes.

steps.title: Select patterns while stopped
steps.caption: Selecting song slot 2 then slot 1 sends MIDI program values 1 then 0 on channel 10. The receiver’s human pattern labels are 2 then 1.

steps.title: Announce the incoming slot early
steps.caption: While four-step song slots alternate, each incoming slot receives exactly one program-change announcement at least half a step before its first note. Play first names the playing slot.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Choose channel one
steps.caption: In native PARAMS, Elektron p.change channel visibly reads 1 after changing it from the default 10.

steps.title: The next selection uses channel one
steps.caption: Selecting song slot 2 sends program value 1 on MIDI channel 1, confirming the changed routing.
